startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Catalog pages to start from. Prefill uses the public Books to Scrape sandbox.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum dataset rows / item-scraped PPE charges. Prefill: 10.

followPagination.title: Follow pagination
followPagination.description: Enqueue Next links on catalog pages.

scrapeDetails.title: Scrape detail pages
scrapeDetails.description: When true, open each book page for UPC, category, and description. When false, push listing cards only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually off for books.toscrape.com. Enable if you adapt this template to a blocked target.
